Question
========
Put the following operations in the order in which a CPU performs them, writing something like CDEAB.

A) Write result
B) Read operands
C) Jump if the instruction was a jump
D) Decode instruction
E) Perform operation
F) Fetch instruction

Solution
========
The classical cycle is: fetch the instruction, decode it, read its operands, perform the operation, write the result back, and only then take the branch if it was one.

Answer: FDBEAC
